jobs.summary: Founded and built a job marketplace for blue and grey-collar workers in Nigeria. Took the first version, a WhatsApp-native platform with a direct Meta API integration, to 300 users as a solo developer, and am now building the mobile app launching in December.

Sole frontend engineer at a healthcare startup. Built the complete client, from the web app to the admin dashboard, including telemedicine, AI-driven insights, and payments, and optimized it to a 95 Lighthouse performance score and a perfect 100 SEO score.
Built the company's first full website from scratch and redesigned the marketing site, resolving every dead link to improve SEO and user experience.
Delivered production-ready Next.js 15 features with 100% design accuracy from Figma, while improving Core Web Vitals and integrating REST APIs.
